source_metadata.title: Adjusted Versus Total Body Weight Dosing for Intravenous Heparin Infusions and Target Attainment in Obese Patients
source_metadata.source_type: Original Research Article; single-center retrospective observational cohort study

source_consistency_notes: Methods list concurrent use of additional anticoagulants as an exclusion criterion, but Figure 1 lists 211 exclusions entirely accounted for by five other categories and does not display an additional-anticoagulant exclusion count. No count was inferred.
extraction_limitations: Extraction was restricted to study-specific methods, population characteristics, reported study results, author interpretations/conclusions, limitations, and disclosures; background claims derived from cited secondary/primary literature were not atomized as if generated by this study.

The article reports mostly arm-wise values and P values rather than comparative effect estimates with confidence intervals. For schema compliance, quantitative atoms use the reported ABW arm value as the required estimate and preserve both cohort values in arms plus the source row values in original_result_text; no unreported effect size was invented.
For 24-hour and subgroup outcomes, overall subgroup sample sizes were not calculated when not explicitly stated; source-reported arm denominators are retained instead.
No external verification of cited literature, assay methodology, or clinical practice guidance was performed.
All atoms remain review_status=needs_review because no independent human verification was performed.
